summary: Bien Doan, a San Jose District 7 City Council member, joined a unanimous council statement on January 17, 2024, calling for a ceasefire, humanitarian aid to Gaza, and hostage release from both Hamas and Israel. The statement addresses the humanitarian crisis and calls for an end to hostilities, framing the hostage issue as a mutual obligation of both parties.
